title: 生体計測
subtitle: Biomedical Instrumentation
educationalGoal: Students will learn: (1) how to measure bioelectric activity of nerves and muscles. (2) principles of various sensors for electric and magnetic measurements. (3) basic electric circuits used in measuring instruments. (4) basic signal processing methods for data analysis.
advice: There are a variety of biological signals that are measured with different physicochemical attributes such as electrical, mechanical and chemical signals. In this course, students will learn the following topics: (1) Biosignals and bioelectric signals (2) Sensors and amplifiers (3) Basics of signal and data processing (4) Principles and application of magnetoencephalogram
requiredKnowledge: Basic knowledge of mathematics and electric circuits.

activityGoals.body: Ability to explain the electrical phenomena of excitement of neuron and muscle.
Ability to explain the basic system of measuring biological signals.
Ability to explain the Fourier transform and power spectrum for basic digital processing.
